title: Benchmark catalog
subtitle: Add a ready-made benchmark to your project in one click. Examples and bundled suites copy straight in; public benchmarks import from a dataset you upload or the server fetches from a public URL.
fromHelp: For data already on the server (local mode or HEIMDALL_DATASETS_DIR). Relative paths resolve against your project folder.
loadError: Could not load the catalog. Check that the server is running, then reload.
empty: No benchmarks match. Clear the search or pick another filter.
noSource: This server could not find its bench folder, so examples and bundled suites are hidden. Ask the server owner to set HEIMDALL_CATALOG_ROOT.
starter: Every new org starts with these agents: {{agents}}.
importStarted: Import job started. Its log is below; the suite appears when it finishes.
uploadHelp: Expects: {{expects}}. Up to 64 MiB; a zip is unpacked. It is stored in {{path}} and replaces the last upload.
urlHelp: The server downloads it (public https only, up to 64 MiB, 3 minute limit) into your uploads area, then imports. Private or gated data: download it yourself and use Upload dataset.
cardFetchKnown: works, the public URL is prefilled
cardFetchAny: works with a public https link to that file
cardFetchNo: not possible (gated or needs extra steps); upload instead
